title: Linearized Wasserstein dimensionality reduction with approximation guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2302.07373v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce LOT Wassmap, a computationally feasible algorithm to uncover low-dimensional structures in the Wasserstein space. The algorithm is motivated by the observation that many datasets are naturally interpreted as probability measures rather than points in $\mathbb{R}^n$, and that finding low-dimensional descriptions of such datasets requires manifold learning algorithms in the Wasserstein space. Most available algorithms are based on computing the pairwise Wasserstein distance matrix, which can be computationally challenging for large datasets in high dimensions. Our algorithm leverages approximation schemes such as Sinkhorn distances and linearized optimal transport to speed-up computations, and in particular, avoids computing a pairwise distance matrix. translated_title: 具有近似保证的线性化Wasserstein降维方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LOT Wassmap，一种计算上可行的算法，用于揭示Wasserstein空间中的低维结构。该算法的动机来自这样一个观察：许多数据集天然地应被理解为概率测度而非$\mathbb{R}^n$中的点，而为此类数据集寻找低维描述需要在Wasserstein空间中使用流形学习算法。现有的大多数算法都依赖于计算两两Wasserstein距离矩阵，这对于高维大规模数据集而言在计算上极具挑战性。我们的算法利用Sinkhorn距离和线性化最优传输等近似方案来加速计算，尤其避免了计算两两距离矩阵。我们为在这种近似下的嵌入质量提供了理论保证，包括当概率测度的显式表达不可用、而必须处理从测度中采样得到的样本的情形。
tldr: 该论文提出LOT Wassmap算法，利用Sinkhorn距离和线性化最优传输等近似方案避免计算两两Wasserstein距离矩阵，从而高效揭示概率测度数据集在Wasserstein空间中的低维结构，并为此类近似下的嵌入质量提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LOT Wassmap, a computationally feasible algorithm that leverages Sinkhorn distances and linearized optimal transport to avoid computing pairwise Wasserstein distance matrices, efficiently uncovering low-dimensional structures of probability measure datasets in Wasserstein space with theoretical guarantees on embedding quality under these approximations.
